decision_rationale: The current contract supports one deterministic first-billing observation per policy with explicit follow-up, but its balanced scenarios, simplified single-cycle paths, and small corpus cannot support real-world performance claims.

available: visible event counts by supported family
prohibited: terminal outcomes and final status in features
policy or event identifiers in features

limitations: The 50 percent positive fraction is engineered scenario coverage, not prevalence.
One observation per policy does not establish a production observation cadence.
The explicit evaluation watermark is an experiment boundary, not an event inferred from history end.
The corpus contains simplified one-cycle paths and only 100 fictional policies.
The gate supports engineering evaluation only, not actuarial, fairness, causal, or business claims.

observation_contract.censoring_policy: right-censor when follow-up ends before the horizon or a horizon outcome is not ingested by the evaluation watermark
observation_contract.eligibility: policy status is active at as_of under dual-time visibility
observation_contract.negative_policy: no qualifying outcome and complete explicit follow-up
observation_contract.outcome_policy: binary adverse termination: lapse or surrender
